cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 58% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +0.58% · WTI -3.63% · Brent +1.19% · NatGas -6.07%. 58% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Power & IPPs is doing the heavy lifting at +1.08%.

cards.headline: Power & IPPs leads, Grid, Storage & Electrification lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Power & IPPs at +1.08%; weakest is Grid, Storage & Electrification at -2.10%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: RUN is the standout at +9.87%
cards.body: Leaders: RUN +9.87%, ENPH +5.22%, SEDG +4.19%, WFRD +2.92%, ARRY +2.15%. Laggards: EOSE -7.18%, PWR -3.62%, ET -2.78%, ETN -2.43%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.
